import csv, collections
ts="20f10a84-4ec1-54ad-896a-1b534d833709"
data=collections.defaultdict(list)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row["timeseries_id"]==ts:
            data[row["timestamp"]].append(row["value"])
ts_all=sorted(data)
print(ts_all[0], ts_all[-1], len(ts_all))
jul=[t for t in ts_all if t.startswith("2018-07")]
print(len(jul))
# check for duplicates
dups=[t for t in data if len(data[t])>1]
print("dups", dups[:5])

import csv, collections
ts="20f10a84-4ec1-54ad-896a-1b534d833709"
dayvals=collections.defaultdict(list)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row["timeseries_id"]==ts:
            t=row["timestamp"]
            dayvals[t[:10]].append(float(row["value"]))
days={d:sum(v) for d,v in dayvals.items() if len(v)==24 and d.startswith("2018-07")}
print(len(days))
mx=max(days.values())
best=min(d for d,v in days.items() if v==mx)
print(mx, best)
# show top few
srt=sorted(days.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])[:5]
print(srt)
ties=[d for d,v in days.items() if v==mx]
print("ties:", ties)
